usage: 茶餐廳 is a noun used to describe a type of cafe commonly found in Hong Kong.
You can use 茶餐廳 to refer to a place where people eat casual meals and drink tea or coffee.
茶餐廳 is often used as a location in sentences, like ‘in the cafe’ or ‘go to the cafe.’
It can be combined with verbs like 去 (go), 食 (eat), or 飲 (drink) to form common phrases.
茶餐廳 usually refers to an informal and local-style eating place, so it is not formal restaurant.
